data.title: list_questions — cross-plan open question scanner
data.summary: New store fn list_questions_across(project, open_only=True) + MCP tool _list_questions. Returns {project, count, questions[{slug, question_id, section, body, opened_by, opened_at}]}.

sections.body: Add list_questions_across(project: str, open_only: bool = True) -> list[dict] to reckon/_store.py. Same glob pattern as list_followups_across. For each plan file, iterates data.get('questions', []). When open_only=True, skips items where q.get('resolved_at') is truthy. Returns {slug, question_id, section, body, opened_by, opened_at}.

Add _list_questions(project: str, open_only: bool = True) to reckon/mcp.py. Returns {project, count, questions}. Register with mcp.tool(). Add ListQuestionsArgs(project: str, open_only: bool = True) to reckon/_mcp_tools.py.

In tests/test_mcp_tools.py: test_list_questions_open_only (resolved questions excluded), test_list_questions_all (open_only=False includes resolved), test_list_questions_cross_plan (aggregation across 2 plan files).
